question: Should OpenClaw add task-level model metadata to `HEARTBEAT.md`, or should heartbeat model selection remain a whole-turn/plugin-routing concern?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but implementation changes a public heartbeat task format and provider/session routing semantics; automation should not choose that API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design shared task-routing contract first
options.body: Define syntax, per-model grouping or per-task execution, fallback/auth behavior, and state-update semantics before implementation.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only `model` task field
options.body: Support a narrow `model:` field in `HEARTBEAT.md` with explicit split/group behavior and validation, accepting a new public task metadata surface.

options.title: Decline core task syntax
options.body: Keep `heartbeat.model` as the supported heartbeat control and document plugin `before_model_resolve` as whole-turn routing only.

recommendation.title: Design shared task-routing contract first
recommendation.body: Define syntax, per-model grouping or per-task execution, fallback/auth behavior, and state-update semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a public config/task-format and provider-routing decision, and steipete has adjacent heartbeat config/product-boundary history.
